messages:
maria ng: heads-up for tomorrow's weekly KPI review — dashboards showing 415 leads tied to the launch posts timeframe but HubSpot only lists 295 with the launch UTM. anyone see obvious drift? :thinking:
aj: which dashboard link? i want to check attribution windows
maria ng: https://app.redwood/dashboards/lead-flow?view=launch_posts — looks like our viz uses first_touch by default
samir: that explains part of it. HS is last_touch by default. also saw a burst of webinar-related conversions around the same spike which might be double-counted if users hit both flows
chloe: i can split the cohort: launch-posts only vs launch-posts + webinar referrer. will post a pivot in a few mins
ben (sales): fwiw sales pipeline shows ~275 records for that period. routing might have reassigned some leads to other campaigns when marketo engaged
maria ng: ok action items: 1) samir run a quick dedup SQL (distinct email) over that week and group by utm_campaign 2) aj confirm dashboard's attribution toggle + add a footnote 3) chloe produce the cross-ref pivot 4) ben confirm SFDC lead owners for the top 20 by ARR
samir: running now. sql:
```sql
select utm_campaign, count(distinct email) as dedup_leads
from events.leads
where received_at >= '2026-03-10' and received_at < '2026-03-17'
group by utm_campaign
order by dedup_leads desc;
```
results will be up in ~5
aj: i'll add a tiny badge on the viz: "first_touch (default) — hover to change to last_touch" and push a note to the dashboard readme
chloe: pivot uploaded: launch_only=310, launch_then_webinar=62, webinar_only=48 — seems like overlap accounts for ~62 leads
growth-bot: weekly-kpi-summary: launch_posts_dashboard=415, hubspot_launch_tagged=295, sfdc_period=275, webinar_signups=110
samir: SQL counts finished: dedup_leads for campaign "launch-q2" = 372 (distinct emails). difference looks like attribution window + multi-touch overlap
maria ng: helpful. for the review we'll show three numbers: raw dashboard (first_touch) 415, deduped distinct emails 372, hubspot-tagged 295. note: routing & SFDC owner split may reduce what sales sees
ben (sales): can marketing add a small conversion-to-mql metric on the dashboard? leadership always asks and it's quick to add
aj: yes — adding conv->mql sparkline to the top-right. will push before 9:30 TOM
maria ng: perfect. meet TOM 9:30 to finalize talking points and one-pager. thanks team :rocket:
